character_reference: a tall, lean man with messy dark hair, wearing a worn charcoal-grey tactical jacket with glowing amber circuitry patterns running down his sleeves
story_so_far: After surviving Commander Vance's ambush and a collapsing dimension, Kael descended into a mysterious subterranean abyss and infiltrated a hidden shadow empire facility. While uncovering their dark blueprints and evading lockdown, he discovered a mysterious containment lab, only to walk straight into Commander Vance's trap and plummet into a crackling electrical abyss.
